text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall but had several losing months, so I should assess progress over many periods and compare it with the market before judging my approach.","I added to Stock C at progressively higher prices, then sold the position below cost; I should set clear criteria for adding and exiting rather than letting a position grow without a plan.","Frequent changes to Stocks A, B, and C did not guarantee better results; I should trade only when my reasons are stronger than the case for holding cash or my existing positions."]}
